issues.title: The main program entry file
issues.body:
Hello!  

Thank you very much for sharing your excellent work and making the code publicly available. I truly appreciate the effort you've put into this project.  

I have a question: it seems that the repository doesn’t include a unified entry point (e.g., `main.py` or `run.py`) to run the project. Could you please share the main execution script?

Thanks again for your great contribution!
